deep_description_en: PLACEHOLDER — Phase 2.5 will author the 300-500 word body for the ES cell (The Charismatic Closer). Theme: Enterprising-dominant + Social-supporting; relationship-led seller who converts trust into commercial outcome. To be drafted by GPT-4o with native Indian copywriter review. The body will weave stress signals, growth edges, and identity claims ("I'm the kind of person who…") in a way that feels recognisably ES, not generic. Hinglish accents (Sharma ji, Aunty, EMI culture) appear only when they earn their place, and the dark-humor IBTI roast is balanced with a warmth temperature appropriate to this archetype — sharper for cells like EC and CE, gentler for SI and IS.
strengths_en: Persuasive framing that aligns diverse stakeholders
High energy across long sales and leadership cycles
Risk-tolerant bet-sizing on people and ideas
Charismatic recovery from setbacks and rejections
growth_tips_en: Slow down to listen before pitching when stakes feel highest
Pair with a detail-oriented operator to ground big visions in execution
Run post-mortems on losses to convert charisma into compounding wisdom
Schedule structured reflection time to balance constant action mode
Commit to a weekly numbers ritual so storytelling stays tied to data

I'm ES. 6.5% rare. I remember every client's kid's name. It's a feature.
